name: Quadtree Raycasting
definition: A recursive ray-quadtree intersection algorithm that traverses a 2D quadtree to find the first hit node. It handles ray direction flipping via a mask to ensure consistent traversal order regardless of ray direction.
summary: Quadtree Raycasting is a recursive algorithm that efficiently finds the first solid node in a 2D quadtree by skipping empty subtrees and adapting traversal to hierarchical boundaries rather than uniform grids.
